alluring.en: The bakery window's alluring display of warm croissants stopped pedestrians mid-stride.
alluring.zh: 麵包店櫥窗裡誘人的熱可頌陳列，讓路人腳步一頓停住。

charisma.en: Even skeptics admitted the mayor's quiet charisma pulled volunteers into late-night canvassing.
charisma.zh: 連懷疑者也承認，市長那種沉穩的魅力把志工拉進了深夜掃街。

beguiling.en: Her beguiling smile made the tedious fundraising pitch feel almost like a conversation.
beguiling.zh: 她迷人的微笑，讓冗長的募款推銷聽起來幾乎像在聊天。

captivating.en: The street musician's captivating melody emptied nearby cafés of their afternoon chatter.
captivating.zh: 街頭樂手那迷人的旋律，讓附近咖啡館午後的閒聊都安靜下來。

enchanting.en: Fireflies rose over the marsh in an enchanting cloud that silenced the entire camping trip.
enchanting.zh: 螢火蟲在沼澤上空升起，形成一片令人著迷的光雲，整趟露營瞬間安靜。

magnetic.en: His magnetic storytelling kept the restless kids leaning forward through every chapter.
magnetic.zh: 他有吸引力的說書方式，讓躁動的孩子每章都往前傾身聽。

abhorrent.en: Dumping chemical waste into the creek was an abhorrent act that shocked the whole town.
abhorrent.zh: 把化學廢料倒進溪裡是令人厭惡的行為，震驚了整座小鎮。

anathema.en: To the veteran librarian, dog-earing pages remained an absolute anathema in any reading room.
anathema.zh: 對資深館員來說，把書頁折角在任何閱覽室都是絕對令人討厭的事。

loathsome.en: The loathsome smell of spoiled seafood clung to the alley long after the market closed.
loathsome.zh: 市場打烊後，那股可憎的腐海鮮味仍在小巷裡久久不散。

revolting.en: Finding a revolting film of grease on every plate, the diners asked for a full refund.
revolting.zh: 發現每隻盤子都蓋著一層令人反感的油膜，食客們要求全額退費。

off-putting.en: His off-putting habit of interrupting every speaker emptied the workshop of volunteers.
off-putting.zh: 他那種打斷每位發言者、讓人倒胃口的習慣，把工作坊的志工都勸走了。

distasteful.en: Joking about the flood victims struck everyone as deeply distasteful at the benefit dinner.
distasteful.zh: 在募款晚宴上拿水患災民開玩笑，大家都覺得極度令人反感。

magnet.en: She stuck the grocery list to the fridge with a tiny strawberry-shaped magnet from Japan.
magnet.zh: 她用一枚從日本帶回來的小草莓磁鐵，把購物清單貼在冰箱上。

roachsticker.en: He peeled a dusty roachsticker off the pantry wall and swore never to ignore kitchen crumbs again.
roachsticker.zh: 他從食品儲藏室牆上撕下一張髒兮兮的蟑螂貼，發誓再也不忽視廚房地屑。

boundary.en: Yellow tape marked the boundary around the sinkhole, warning drivers to choose another lane.
boundary.zh: 黃膠帶圍出天坑周圍的警戒線，提醒駕駛改走另一車道。

stink.en: A sharp stink of burnt rubber drifted from the garage after the brakes overheated on the hill.
stink.zh: 煞車在坡道上過熱後，車庫飄出一股刺鼻的燒橡膠臭味。

selfie.en: Before boarding, she snapped a quick selfie with the mountain behind her for the group chat.
selfie.zh: 登機前，她以山景為背景拍了一張快速自拍，傳給群組。

charm.en: Grandma pressed a silver charm into my palm and whispered that it once guarded travelers.
charm.zh: 外婆把一枚銀製魅力符塞進我掌心，低聲說它曾守護過旅人。

yuck.en: The toddler yelled "yuck" and shoved the broccoli across the tray with both sticky hands.
yuck.zh: 幼兒大喊「噁」，用兩隻黏糊糊的手把花椰菜推過餐盤。

commence.en: Please commence packing only after the checklist has been signed by both supervisors.
commence.zh: 請等兩位主管都簽完檢查表後，再開始著手打包。

incipient.en: Nurses spotted the patient's incipient fever hours before the overnight spike arrived.
incipient.zh: 護理師在夜間高燒來臨前數小時，就察覺到病人起始的發燒跡象。

originate.en: Historians still debate whether the folk tune could originate in the coastal fishing villages.
originate.zh: 史學家仍在爭論這首民謠是否可能起源於沿海漁村。

culminate.en: Months of messy rehearsals would culminate in one glittering opening night under the lights.
culminate.zh: 數月凌亂的排練，將在燈光下那個璀璨的開幕夜達到高潮。

abortive.en: Their abortive attempt to launch the app taught them more than any successful demo could.
abortive.zh: 那次失敗流產的上線嘗試，教給他們的比任何成功演示都多。

embark.en: At dawn the crew will embark on a three-week survey of the coral reefs offshore.
embark.zh: 黎明時分，船員將啟程著手進行為期三週的近岸珊瑚礁調查。

initiate.en: The principal decided to initiate a peer-tutoring program after math scores stalled.
initiate.zh: 校長在數學成績停滯後，決定發起同儕輔導計畫。

nascence.en: In the nascence of the podcast, the hosts recorded episodes under a quilt to cut echoes.
nascence.zh: 在播客誕生初期，主持人為了消音，整集都在棉被下錄音。

outset.en: From the outset the coach insisted that every player learn both offense and defense.
outset.zh: 從開端起，教練就堅持每位球員都要學會進攻與防守。

culmination.en: The parade was the culmination of a year spent sewing costumes and drilling formations.
culmination.zh: 遊行是整年縫製服裝、操練隊形之後最終的頂峯。

denouement.en: In the novel's quiet denouement, the rivals finally share tea without trading insults.
denouement.zh: 小說平靜的結局收場裡，宿敵終於對坐喝茶，不再互罵。

windup.en: During the festival's windup, vendors packed tents while leftover lanterns still glowed.
windup.zh: 節慶收尾時，攤商收拾帳篷，殘餘的燈籠仍亮著。

curtain.en: When the heavy curtain rose, dust motes danced in the spotlight above the empty stage.
curtain.zh: 厚重的幕升起時，塵埃在空蕩舞台上方的聚光燈裡飛舞。

starter.en: The runner crouched beside the metal starter, waiting for the official's sharp command.
starter.zh: 跑者蹲在金屬起跑器旁，等待裁判尖銳的發令。

epilogue2.en: Fans joked that epilogue2 revealed more plot twists than the entire second season combined.
epilogue2.zh: 粉絲開玩笑說，後記2揭露的劇情轉折比整個第二季加起來還多。

gun.en: At the starter's gun, every sprinter exploded forward as the crowd roared from the stands.
gun.zh: 發令槍一響，每位短跑選手瞬間衝出，看台觀眾齊聲歡呼。

bow.en: After the final chord, the pianist took a deep bow while flowers landed at her feet.
bow.zh: 最後一個和弦後，鋼琴家深深鞠躬謝幕，花束落在她腳邊。

overture.en: Soft drinks and small talk served as the overture to the long negotiation that followed.
overture.zh: 飲料與寒暄成了接下來漫長談判的前言前奏。

closing.en: Staff began the store's closing routine by dimming lights and counting the cash drawers.
closing.zh: 店員開始商店的關閉流程：調暗燈光、清點錢匣。

kickoff.en: The referee placed the ball for kickoff as both teams lined up under a gray sky.
kickoff.zh: 裁判把球放好準備開球，兩隊在灰濛天空下列好陣勢。

wrap.en: The director yelled wrap after the stunt team nailed the rooftop chase on the third take.
wrap.zh: 特技組第三次就拍成屋頂追逐後，導演大喊收工。

dawn.en: Hikers left the trailhead at dawn so they could reach the ridge before the heat rose.
dawn.zh: 健行者在黎明就離開登山口，好在暑氣升起前抵達山脊。

dusk.en: By dusk the plaza vendors were folding tables and sweeping cinnamon sugar from the stones.
dusk.zh: 到了黃昏，廣場攤商折起桌子，掃走石板上的肉桂糖屑。

ribbon.en: The mayor snipped the ceremonial ribbon and the new clinic doors swung open to applause.
ribbon.zh: 市長剪下儀式綵帶，新診所大門在掌聲中敞開。

exitlamp.en: A flickering exitlamp above the stairwell guided the late audience out after the encore.
exitlamp.zh: 加演結束後，樓梯間上方閃爍的出口燈引導晚離場的觀眾走出去。

birth.en: Neighbors celebrated the birth of twins by hanging paper cranes along the apartment hallway.
birth.zh: 鄰居在公寓走廊掛起紙鶴，慶祝雙胞胎的誕生。

tombstone.en: The detective closed the cold case with a brief tombstone note in the archive ledger.
tombstone.zh: 警探在檔案簿上寫下一則簡短墓碑結案註記，了結這樁冷案。

daunt.en: The sheer height of the climbing wall did not daunt the smallest kid in the gym class.
daunt.zh: 攀岩牆的驚人高度，並沒有嚇倒體育課裡個子最小的孩子。

undaunted.en: Undaunted by two rejected drafts, she mailed a sharper proposal the following Monday.
undaunted.zh: 兩份草稿被拒也不氣餒，她下週一又寄出更鋒利的企劃。

pluck.en: It took real pluck for the intern to challenge the outdated spreadsheet in front of executives.
pluck.zh: 實習生當著高管面挑戰過時試算表，需要真正的勇氣膽識。

gutsy.en: Choosing the untested trail in fog was a gutsy call that paid off with a hidden waterfall.
gutsy.zh: 在濃霧中選未測路線是有膽的決定，換來一座隱密瀑布。

mettlesome.en: The mettlesome mare refused the easy path and leapt the muddy ditch without hesitation.
mettlesome.zh: 那匹驍勇的母馬拒絕走平路，毫不猶豫躍過泥溝。

doughty.en: A doughty volunteer waded into the flooded basement to rescue the stranded cats.
doughty.zh: 一位勇敢堅毅的志工涉入淹水的地下室，救出受困的貓。

stouthearted.en: The stouthearted courier crossed the icy bridge twice to deliver medicine before midnight.
stouthearted.zh: 剛毅大膽的快遞員兩次穿越結冰橋，只為在午夜前送達藥品。

lionhearted.en: Her lionhearted speech before the board forced a vote on the long-buried safety report.
lionhearted.zh: 她獅心般的董事會發言，迫使大家對塵封已久的安全報告投票。

poltroon.en: Nobody wanted a poltroon as lookout when the night rescue depended on steady nerves.
poltroon.zh: 夜間救援仰賴鎮定神經時，沒人想要一個懦夫當哨兵。

recreant.en: The recreant messenger fled with the sealed orders instead of delivering them to the fort.
recreant.zh: 那個怯懦背信的信使帶著密封命令逃走，沒送到要塞。

dastardly.en: Sabotaging the rival team's water bottles was a dastardly trick that emptied the stands.
dastardly.zh: 破壞對手水壺是卑鄙怯懦的伎倆，看台觀眾也因此散去。

chickenhearted.en: The chickenhearted scout turned back at the first creek, leaving the map unfinished.
chickenhearted.zh: 膽小如雞的斥候在第一條小溪就折返，地圖因此沒畫完。

fainthearted.en: This canyon hike is not for the fainthearted; the final ledge drops steeply into mist.
fainthearted.zh: 這條峽谷步道不適合懦弱者；最後的岩架陡降進霧裡。

spineless.en: A spineless manager blamed the interns rather than admit the schedule was impossible.
spineless.zh: 沒骨氣的主管把責任推給實習生，不肯承認時程本來就不可行。

roar.en: A sudden roar from the home crowd rattled the visiting pitcher into a wild throw.
roar.zh: 主場觀眾突然的咆哮，讓客隊投手慌到投出暴投。

shell.en: The hermit crab traded its cracked shell for a larger one washed up after the tide.
shell.zh: 寄居蟹把裂開的殼換成潮水過後沖上岸的更大一枚。

medal.en: She pinned the bronze medal beside her grandfather's faded campaign ribbons on the shelf.
medal.zh: 她把銅質勳章別在書架上祖父褪色的戰役綬帶旁邊。

whiteflag.en: When the rain flooded the pitch, both captains raised a whiteflag and agreed to reschedule.
whiteflag.zh: 雨水淹沒球場時，兩隊隊長舉起白旗，同意改期再賽。

charge.en: At the whistle the defenders began a reckless charge toward the loose ball near midfield.
charge.zh: 哨聲一響，防守球員朝中場附近的散球開始魯莽衝鋒。

retreat.en: Smoke forced a quick retreat from the attic until firefighters cleared the blocked vent.
retreat.zh: 濃煙迫使眾人迅速從閣樓撤退，直到消防員清通堵塞的通風口。

armor.en: Museum lights glowed on the dented armor that once protected a knight in muddy tournaments.
armor.zh: 博物館燈光照在凹痕累累的盔甲上，那曾在泥濘比武中保護騎士。

quiver.en: A quiver ran through her hands when the ice cracked under the first cautious step.
quiver.zh: 她小心踩出第一步時冰塊裂開，一陣顫抖傳過雙手。

backbone.en: Community organizers became the backbone of the relief effort after the hurricane passed.
backbone.zh: 颶風過後，社區組織者成了救災行動的脊梁。

knees.en: His knees went soft on the rope bridge, and he sat down until the swaying slowed.
knees.zh: 他在吊橋上膝蓋發軟，只好坐下等到晃動緩和。

trumpet.en: A solitary trumpet announced the procession long before the banners appeared around the bend.
trumpet.zh: 孤獨的號角宣告隊伍到來，遠在旗幟轉過彎角之前。

succinct.en: Please leave a succinct note on the whiteboard so the next shift knows what failed overnight.
succinct.zh: 請在白板上留下簡潔的註記，讓下一班知道夜間何處出了問題。

terse.en: His terse reply of "already fixed" ended the long chain of anxious midnight emails.
terse.zh: 他簡潔回覆「已經修好」，結束了一長串焦慮的午夜郵件。

curt.en: A curt "busy" from the desk clerk made the waiting passengers exchange uneasy glances.
curt.zh: 櫃檯人員言詞簡略的一句「很忙」，讓候機乘客互投不安目光。

compact.en: She packed a compact overnight bag that somehow held boots, a laptop, and two novels.
compact.zh: 她塞好一個緊湊結實的過夜包，居然裝下靴子、筆電與兩本小說。

concise.en: Keep the lab abstract concise, but never delete the assumptions that shaped the method.
concise.zh: 實驗摘要要簡明，但絕不要刪掉塑造方法的那些假設。

fabricate.en: Workers can fabricate the metal brackets on-site, yet nobody should fabricate the safety logs.
fabricate.zh: 工人可在現場製造金屬支架，但誰都不該捏造安全紀錄。

forge.en: In the hot forge, the blacksmith shaped a hinge that would outlast the wooden door itself.
forge.zh: 在炙熱鍛造爐旁，鐵匠打出一枚比木門更耐用的鉸鏈。

assemble.en: Students had one hour to assemble the robot chassis before the practice match began.
assemble.zh: 學生們有一小時組裝機器人底盤，然後練習賽就要開始。

raze.en: City planners voted to raze the condemned warehouse rather than patch its leaning walls.
raze.zh: 市規劃者投票要摧毀那座危樓倉庫，而不是修補傾斜的牆。

ruin.en: One careless cigarette nearly brought ruin to the century-old timber mill by the river.
ruin.zh: 一根隨意的香菸，幾乎把河邊百年木廠帶向毀滅。

devastate.en: The flash flood would devastate the valley gardens before residents could sandbag the gates.
devastate.zh: 山洪會在居民來得及堆沙袋擋門前，摧毀山谷裡的園圃。

scaffold.en: Painters climbed the rattling scaffold to reach the mural high on the theater facade.
scaffold.zh: 油漆工爬上晃動的鷹架，去夠戲院外牆上高處的壁畫。

crane.en: A yellow crane lifted steel beams over the street while traffic waited behind orange cones.
crane.zh: 黃色吊車把鋼樑吊過街道，車流在橘色錐桶後等候。

helmet.en: She strapped on her scratched helmet before pedaling into the morning bike-share lane.
helmet.zh: 她扣上刮痕累累的安全帽，才騎進早晨的共享單車道。

calendar.en: He circled the audition date on the kitchen calendar and taped a reminder next to it.
calendar.zh: 他在廚房日曆上圈出試鏡日期，旁邊再貼一張提醒。

hardhat.en: Every visitor borrowed a bright hardhat before stepping onto the unfinished skywalk.
hardhat.zh: 每位訪客都要借一頂鮮亮的工地帽，才能走上未完工的空中走廊。

halcyon.en: She still spoke of those hazy summers as the family's last truly halcyon years together.
halcyon.zh: 她仍把那些朦朧夏日，說成全家最後真正平靜安好的歲月。

equanimity.en: He faced the canceled flight with surprising equanimity and simply opened a paperback.
equanimity.zh: 他以出奇的鎮靜面對班機取消，乾脆打開一本平裝書。

serene.en: The lake stayed serene at sunrise even while distant trucks rumbled along the highway.
serene.zh: 日出時湖面依舊寧靜，儘管遠處公路上卡車隆隆駛過。

composed.en: She stayed composed while explaining the delay, never raising her voice at the angry queue.
composed.zh: 她解釋延誤時保持鎮靜，從不對憤怒的隊伍提高音量。

blatant.en: Leaving the emergency exit chained shut was a blatant violation of every fire code in town.
blatant.zh: 把緊急出口用鏈鎖死，是對鎮上每條消防法規的厚顏無恥違反。

fray.en: A parking dispute quickly became a shouting fray that drew neighbors onto the sidewalk.
fray.zh: 停車糾紛很快變成大聲爭吵，把鄰居都引到人行道上看。

tempestuous.en: Their tempestuous partnership produced brilliant albums and equally spectacular breakups.
tempestuous.zh: 他們劇烈起伏的合作關係產出精彩專輯，也帶來同樣轟動的分手。

lake.en: Fog lifted off the lake just enough for kayakers to spot the red buoy near the dock.
lake.zh: 霧從湖面稍稍升起，剛好讓獨木舟手看見碼頭旁的紅浮標。

storm.en: A sudden storm tore laundry from the lines and sent neighbors racing for open windows.
storm.zh: 突來的暴風把衣物從晾繩扯下，鄰居紛紛衝去關開著的窗。

lifebuoy.en: The deckhand tossed a bright lifebuoy toward the swimmer who had drifted past the pier.
lifebuoy.zh: 水手把鮮亮的救生圈拋向漂過碼頭的泳客。

wharf.en: Fishermen mended nets along the creaking wharf while gulls circled the morning catch.
wharf.zh: 漁民在吱嘎作響的碼頭邊補網，海鷗繞著清晨漁獲盤旋。

teacup.en: Steam curled from the cracked teacup as she reread the letter for the third quiet hour.
teacup.zh: 蒸汽從有裂紋的茶杯升起，她已靜靜把信讀了第三個小時。

ripple.en: One tossed pebble sent a slow ripple across the pond toward the waiting dragonflies.
ripple.zh: 一顆丟出的小石在池面掀起緩慢漣漪，朝等候的蜻蜓擴散。

siren.en: An ambulance siren cut through the late dinner conversation and froze every fork mid-air.
siren.zh: 救護車警報劃破深夜晚餐談話，每個人的叉子都停在半空。

pillow.en: He buried his face in the cool pillow and tried to forget the unfinished argument downstairs.
pillow.zh: 他把臉埋進冰涼的枕頭，試圖忘掉樓下未完的爭執。

aplomb.en: She handled the live microphone failure with aplomb, joking until the backup cable arrived.
aplomb.zh: 她沉著自信地應付現場麥克風故障，一路開玩笑直到備用線抵達。

poise.en: Years of ballet gave her the poise to walk across the icy plaza without a single slip.
poise.zh: 多年芭蕾賦予她鎮定平衡，能走過結冰廣場而不滑倒一次。

clinch.en: One late free throw would clinch the championship and send the bench storming the court.
clinch.zh: 一記關鍵罰球就能敲定冠軍，讓替補席衝進球場。

unequivocal.en: The coach's unequivocal demand was simple: no phones on the bench during playoff games.
unequivocal.zh: 教練明確清晰的要求很簡單：季後賽期間板凳席禁止手機。

categorical.en: Her categorical refusal to sign left the contract sitting unsigned on the conference table.
categorical.zh: 她斷然絕對的拒絕簽字，讓合約仍攤在會議桌上。

decisive.en: A decisive vote in the morning session ended weeks of deadlock over the budget amendment.
decisive.zh: 上午場一場決定性投票，結束了預算修正案數週的僵局。

indubitable.en: The fingerprint match made his presence at the scene an indubitable fact for the jury.
indubitable.zh: 指紋吻合讓他在場成為陪審團毋庸置疑的事實。

enunciate.en: Please enunciate each syllable clearly so the remote students can follow the new formula.
enunciate.zh: 請把每個音節清晰闡述，讓遠距學生跟得上新公式。

skeptical.en: Investors stayed skeptical until the prototype survived a full week of outdoor stress tests.
skeptical.zh: 投資人保持懷疑，直到原型撐過整整一週的戶外壓力測試。

leery.en: Shoppers grew leery of the too-good coupon after three stores refused to honor it.
leery.zh: 三家店都拒絕兌換後，顧客對那張好得過頭的折價券開始猜疑。

tenuous.en: Their alibi rested on a tenuous claim that both phones had died at the exact same minute.
tenuous.zh: 他們的不在場證明建立在脆弱牽強的說法上：兩支手機同一分鐘沒電。

incertitude.en: A fog of incertitude hung over the election night desk as rural counties delayed returns.
incertitude.zh: 鄉下郡延遲開票時，一層不確定的迷霧籠罩選情夜播報台。

quandary.en: She faced a quandary: miss the interview or leave her feverish brother home alone.
quandary.zh: 她陷入困窘：要麼錯過面試，要麼把發燒的弟弟獨自留在家。

dither.en: Don't dither over font choices while the printer deadline is already twenty minutes past.
dither.zh: 印刷截止已過二十分鐘，別再為字體選擇猶豫不決。

falter.en: His voice did not falter when he told the room that the funding had been withdrawn overnight.
falter.zh: 他告訴全場經費一夜之間被撤時，聲音沒有蹣跚猶豫。

far-fetched.en: Blaming the power outage on migrating birds sounded far-fetched even to patient neighbors.
far-fetched.zh: 把停電怪到候鳥頭上，連有耐心的鄰居都覺得牽強不可信。

inconclusive.en: Two lab runs remained inconclusive, so the team scheduled a third trial under brighter light.
inconclusive.zh: 兩次實驗仍沒有定論，團隊安排在更亮燈光下做第三次試驗。

precarious.en: The ladder leaned at a precarious angle against the wet gutter, swaying with every breeze.
precarious.zh: 梯子以危險不穩的角度靠在濕水槽上，每陣風都晃。

waver.en: Candle flames began to waver as the draft slipped through the cracked window frame.
waver.zh: 穿堂風從裂開的窗框溜入時，燭火開始動搖晃動。

caveat.en: Accept the internship offer with one caveat: unpaid overtime cannot become the default.
caveat.zh: 接受實習offer時要有一則告誡：無薪加班不能變成常態。

agnostic.en: On the origin of the rumor she remained agnostic, refusing to endorse either camp's story.
agnostic.zh: 對於謠言起源她保持不可知論態度，拒絕站任一陣營的說法。

boggle.en: The sticker price alone made him boggle, and he quietly returned the camera to its shelf.
boggle.zh: 光是標價就讓他猶豫驚呆，悄悄把相機放回架上。

stagger.en: Facing two equally urgent deadlines made her stagger between tasks without finishing either.
stagger.zh: 面對兩個同樣緊急的截止日，她猶豫不決地在任務間踱步，哪個都完不成。

tarry.en: Do not tarry in the hallway after the drill bell; teachers need a clear path to the exits.
tarry.zh: 演練鈴響後別在走廊逗留等候；老師需要暢通的逃生通道。

suspicion.en: A faint suspicion that the invoice was duplicated sent the accountant back through last week's mail.
suspicion.zh: 一絲懷疑發票被重複開立，讓會計又翻回上週郵件。

explicit.en: Be explicit about which columns are missing so the cleaning script does not invent values.
explicit.zh: 請明確說明哪些欄位缺失，以免清理腳本憑空捏造數值。

transparent.en: A transparent pricing page listed every fee so shoppers were never surprised at checkout.
transparent.zh: 透明的價格頁列出每項費用，讓買家結帳時從不意外。

vague.en: Vague promises to "fix things later" left the tenants without a date they could trust.
vague.zh: 含糊的「稍後會修」承諾，讓房客沒有可信的日期。

abstruse.en: The abstruse footnote on page forty only confused readers who already understood the theorem.
abstruse.zh: 第四十頁那則深奧難解的腳註，只讓已懂定理的讀者更糊塗。

implicit.en: An implicit trust in the old map nearly sent the hikers down a trail closed for rockfall.
implicit.zh: 對舊地圖的隱含信任，幾乎讓健行者走進因落石封閉的步道。

nebula.en: His proposal dissolved into a nebula of buzzwords that never named a measurable goal.
nebula.zh: 他的提案溶成一團星雲般的術語霧，從未點出可測量目標。

limpid.en: Through the limpid water of the tide pool they could count every striped snail on the rock.
limpid.zh: 透過潮池清澈的水，他們能數清岩石上每隻帶紋螺。

crystalline.en: Her crystalline explanation of the tax rule finally quieted the murmuring in the back row.
crystalline.zh: 她對稅則晶瑩明晰的解釋，終於讓後排的竊竊私語安靜。

nebulous.en: The distinction between pride and vanity stayed nebulous until she offered concrete examples.
nebulous.zh: 自豪與虛榮的界線一直模糊不清，直到她舉出具體例子。

cloudy.en: A cloudy recollection of the password forced him to reset the account before the webinar.
cloudy.zh: 對密碼混濁不清的記憶，迫使他在網路研討會前重設帳號。

windex.en: She sprayed blue windex on the bathroom mirror and wiped until the foggy streaks vanished.
windex.zh: 她把藍色玻璃水噴上浴室鏡子，擦到霧狀水痕消失為止。

fog.en: Thick fog swallowed the ferry pier, leaving only the horn to guide late passengers aboard.
fog.zh: 濃霧吞沒渡輪碼頭，只剩汽笛引導遲到乘客上船。

flashlight.en: A weak flashlight beam found the breaker box behind the stacked paint cans in the basement.
flashlight.zh: 微弱的手電筒光束，在地下室堆疊油漆罐後方找到電閘箱。

blur.en: The passing train was only a silver blur that rattled the café windows for three seconds.
blur.zh: 過路列車只是一道銀色模糊，把咖啡館窗戶震了三秒。

haze.en: A pale haze hung over the rice fields after farmers burned stalks at the season's end.
haze.zh: 農人季末燒稈後，一層薄霧籠罩在稻田上空。

decode.en: It took the club an hour to decode the scavenger-hunt clue hidden inside the old yearbook.
decode.zh: 社團花了一小時才解碼藏在舊年鑑裡的尋寶線索。

opaque-glass.en: Frosted opaque-glass panels shielded the shower while still letting morning light filter through.
opaque-glass.zh: 磨砂霧玻璃隔板遮住淋浴區，仍讓晨光透進來。

sparkle.en: Sunlight made the wet sidewalk sparkle after the brief afternoon shower passed overhead.
sparkle.zh: 一陣午後陣雨過後，陽光讓濕人行道閃閃發亮。

smudge.en: A charcoal smudge on his cheek revealed he had been sketching near the construction fence.
smudge.zh: 臉上的炭筆污點透露他剛在工地圍籬邊素描。

polish.en: She used a soft cloth to polish the brass doorknob until it reflected the hallway lamp.
polish.zh: 她用軟布擦亮黃銅門把，直到它映出走廊燈光。

veil.en: Thick curtains helped veil the rehearsal from curious pedestrians on the rainy street.
veil.zh: 厚窗簾幫忙掩蓋彩排，不讓雨街上好奇的行人窺見。

lantern.en: A paper lantern swayed above the night market stall, casting orange circles on the fruit.
lantern.zh: 一盞紙燈籠在夜市攤上方搖晃，在水果上投下橘色光圈。

mist.en: Morning mist clung to the vineyard rows until the first warm breeze pushed it uphill.
mist.zh: 晨霧黏在葡萄園行列間，直到第一陣暖風把它推上山坡。

shine.en: Please shine the porch light so the delivery driver can find the house number after dark.
shine.zh: 請把門廊燈照亮，好讓送貨司機天黑後找到門牌號碼。

mud.en: Kids tracked wet mud across the kitchen tiles after jumping every puddle on the way home.
mud.zh: 孩子們回家路上跳過每個水坑，把濕泥踩滿廚房地磚。

windowpane.en: Rain tapped the windowpane in a steady rhythm that almost matched the metronome on the piano.
windowpane.zh: 雨水敲打窗玻璃，節奏穩得幾乎跟上鋼琴旁的節拍器。

defog.en: He ran the car's blower to defog the windshield before merging onto the icy highway ramp.
defog.zh: 併入結冰高速公路匝道前，他開起鼓風機為擋風玻璃除霧。

audacious.en: Pitching a free public library inside the mall was an audacious idea that somehow won funding.
audacious.zh: 在購物中心設免費公共圖書館是大膽的構想，居然還拿到經費。

timorous.en: A timorous knock at the office door barely rose above the hum of the copy machine.
timorous.zh: 辦公室門上一記膽小的敲門聲，幾乎蓋不過影印機的嗡嗡。

bold.en: Wear a bold color on stage so the back row can still spot you under the harsh lights.
bold.zh: 上台穿大膽顏色，好讓後排在刺眼燈光下仍能看見你。

disdainful.en: His disdainful glance at the homemade cake silenced the birthday song mid-chorus.
disdainful.zh: 他對自製蛋糕輕蔑的一瞥，讓生日歌在副歌中途安靜。

kowtow.en: She refused to kowtow to the celebrity guest's last-minute demand for a private elevator.
kowtow.zh: 她拒絕為了名人客人臨時要專用電梯而叩頭奉承。
